name: comp-581

frames.best_why: The bell's notifications panel is open with four readable updates while the header stays in view.

tagline: Minimal top bar with help and notification menus beside a user avatar.
summary: A dark site header with a logo, four plain nav links, and three round icon buttons on the right for help, notifications and the user menu; the bell opens a panel of recent updates.
appearance: A dark header with a starburst logo, Home, Features, Pricing and About links, then three round icon buttons on the right: an info mark, a bell and a small avatar. Opening the bell reveals a rounded panel with a title, a Mark all as read link and a list of updates.
behaviour: The info icon opens a short help menu and the bell opens a notifications panel listing review, sharing and assignment updates with timestamps. Each panel closes when the pointer leaves or focus moves away.
demo_content: Updates name Chris Tompson, Emma Davis, James Wilson and Alex Morgan with times like 15 minutes ago.
search_phrases: help and support menu in header
use_when: A signed-in app needs a light header with quick access to help and notifications.
avoid_when: The notification list uses fixed sample names and timestamps, so it still needs wiring to real data.
customise: Nav labels are set in the file; the info, notification and user menus come from separate pieces whose contents you edit there.
weight_why: A row of links, three small buttons and one open panel.

a11y.note: The logo link has no accessible name, and labelling of the icon menus depends on the separate components used.

issues: The open notifications panel is cut off at the bottom of every frame it appears in.
polish_why: Compact, well-balanced header with believable notification content; the panel runs past the crop.
